# Senior Backend Engineer: Final-Round Loop Plan (week of 26 Oct 2026)

## 1. Schedules

**UTC offsets this week.** EU clocks went back on Sunday 25 Oct, but US clocks don't change until Sunday 1 Nov. For this one week, New York is 4 hours behind Lisbon and 5 hours behind Berlin, one hour less than usual.

| City | Offset | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Lisbon | WET, **UTC+0** | EU DST ended Sun 25 Oct |
| Berlin | CET, **UTC+1** | EU DST ended Sun 25 Oct |
| New York | EDT, **UTC−4** | US DST runs until Sun 1 Nov |
| Chicago | CDT, **UTC−5** | US DST runs until Sun 1 Nov |

### Richard Miles: Tuesday 27 October 2026 (30-minute breaks)

| # | Session | Interviewer | UTC | Candidate (Chicago, CDT) | Interviewer local |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | System design | Jane Doe | 14:30–15:15 | 09:30–10:15 | 15:30–16:15 CET (Berlin) |
| 2 | Hiring manager | John Stiles | 15:45–16:30 | 10:45–11:30 | 11:45–12:30 EDT (New York) |
| 3 | Coding | Mary Major | 17:00–17:45 | 12:00–12:45 | 13:00–13:45 EDT (New York) |

Video link for all sessions: `https://meet.example.com/qh-sbe-miles-1027`

### Richard Roe: Wednesday 28 October 2026 (15-minute breaks)

| # | Session | Interviewer | UTC | Candidate (Lisbon, WET) | Interviewer local |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | System design | Jane Doe | 13:00–13:45 | 13:00–13:45 | 14:00–14:45 CET (Berlin) |
| 2 | Coding | Mary Major | 14:00–14:45 | 14:00–14:45 | 10:00–10:45 EDT (New York) |
| 3 | Hiring manager | John Stiles | 15:00–15:45 | 15:00–15:45 | 11:00–11:45 EDT (New York) |

Video link for all sessions: `https://meet.example.com/qh-sbe-roe-1028`

## 2. Why these days and slots

**Days**

- **Richard Miles must be Tuesday.** He is only free Tue or Thu, and Jane is out of office all day Thursday.
- **Richard Roe must be Wednesday.** Each interviewer can do only one final-round session per day, and all three are on both loops. With Tuesday taken by Miles, Wednesday is the only remaining day Roe is available.

**Working hours in UTC**

| Person | Working window (UTC) |
|---|---|
| Jane | 08:00–16:00 |
| Roe | 09:00–17:00 |
| Mary | 13:00–21:00 |
| John | 13:00–21:00 (but standup until 13:30) |
| Miles | 14:00–22:00 |

**Tuesday (Miles)**

- Jane is busy 12:00–14:00 UTC and finishes work at 16:00 UTC. Her session must therefore fit between **14:00 and 16:00 UTC**.
- Mary is busy 15:00–16:00 UTC.
- With 3 × 45-minute sessions and 2 × 30-minute breaks, the loop spans 3 h 15 min.
- **Ruled out:**
  - **Jane last:** the loop would have to start by 12:45 UTC, before Miles's day begins.
  - **Mary second:** this always overlaps her 15:00 UTC meeting.
  - **Mary → Jane → John:** this works, but Jane would finish exactly at 17:00 Berlin.
- **Chosen order: Jane → John → Mary.**
  - Jane gets a 30-minute buffer after her meeting and finishes before her day ends.
  - Miles starts at 09:30 rather than right at 09:00.

**Wednesday (Roe)**

- The only shared window is 13:00–16:00 UTC.
- That is Jane's afternoon and the New York interviewers' morning.
- A Lisbon morning slot is impossible because New York starts at 13:00 UTC.
- I used 15-minute breaks, the minimum allowed, to keep Jane well inside her hours.
- John is placed last so he is clear of his standup.
